message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage. I had just finished reminding my family about the importance of being prepared—flashlights, power banks, the whole shebang. When the lights went out, I felt a little smug as I grabbed my trusty lantern and power bank, while everyone else fumbled around in the dark. 

It was a cozy evening, really. We huddled together, charged up our phones, and even managed to whip up some snacks without missing a beat! 

Sometimes it's the little moments that remind us to be ready for anything. What’s your favorite trick for staying comfortable during a blackout? 🌟
